data.title: 轻井泽惠 · 宿舍地毯宽大卫衣的抱膝游戏私语
data.description: 深夜安静的女生宿舍内，惠穿着宽大的男友风深灰连帽卫衣，光洁双腿蜷缩在绒毛地毯上，双手握着掌机，抬头时满眼依赖与信赖。
data.location: 温馨私密的单人学生宿舍地毯
data.action: 抱膝坐在柔软绒毯上，宽大卫衣下摆遮住短裤，光裸双足蜷缩，抬头展露只给一人的温柔笑容
data.lighting: 暖色落地灯与掌机屏幕投下的柔和光线，营造独处安全感
data.camera: 俯角近景特写，强调娇小可人与毫无防备的亲近
data.promptProse: Kei Karuizawa sits on the plush carpet of her cozy student dormitory room late in the evening, hugging her knees together beneath an oversized charcoal boyfriend hoodie. With her slender bare legs tucked close and a handheld gaming device resting in her lap, she looks up from the glowing screen with an unguarded, profoundly affectionate smile reserved only for her trusted visitor.
data.animaCaption: Curled up on the dorm room rug in an oversized hoodie, Kei looks up from her handheld game with a soft, trusting smile.
